desc:
A specially modified W-Engine that's become hugely popular on Inter-Knot. Some functionality was sacrificed for the sake of its appearance, but that hasn't stopped it from becoming a massive hit.
Even its designer never expected it to be this successful. In an interview, he explained, "In the ever-changing Hollows, the anxiety brought on by uncertainty can easily overwhelm a person's will. For people trapped in desperate situations, even a small sign of good fortune can be enough to give them hope."
"Of course, maybe people just like cats." He added with a laugh at the end of the interview.
desc2: Equip to increase Armorer Agents' combat capabilities
desc3: Meow your way to good luck!
name: Catty Luck
